description:
Configure custom HTTP error pages for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server. 

1. Create a directory '/home/acmecorp/public_html/errors/'.
2. Create a custom 404 error page at '/home/acmecorp/public_html/errors/404.html'. It must contain the heading 'AcmeCorp - Page Not Found', the text 'The page you requested could not be found', and a link back to the homepage (href='/').
3. Create a custom 403 error page at '/home/acmecorp/public_html/errors/403.html'. It must contain the heading 'AcmeCorp - Access Denied' and the text 'You do not have permission to access this resource'.
4. Configure Apache (via Virtualmin or .htaccess) so that the 'acmecorp.test' website serves these files when 404 and 403 errors occur.

You can use the Virtualmin File Manager, the terminal, or any other tool available.

required_content.404_body: The page you requested could not be found
required_content.403_body: You do not have permission to access this resource
